quote.text: One of the causes of the troubles that beset us is the way our lives are guided by the example of others; instead of being set to rights by reason we’re seduced by convention.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Encourage your children to think for themselves, teaching them to value reason over the easy path of following others' expectations.
    • Model a life where personal reflection trumps unexamined convention, so that they learn to form their own meaningful values.
  • Leadership:
    • Lead with clarity by letting reason guide your decisions rather than defaulting to established norms.
    • Inspire your team to challenge conventions, fostering an environment where innovative and well-reasoned ideas can thrive.
  • Product Management:
    • Focus on data and critical evaluation in your strategy, ensuring that innovations are born from thoughtful analysis rather than mere imitation.
    • Promote a culture of questioning the status quo, which can spark creative solutions and drive products that truly resonate with users.
